column1: # osmo_refdb profile report levels: one row per reporting unit (osmotool profile's unit table).
# Decided on the calibration reads (positive.calib + negative.train), never on the benchmark (test) reads.
# Rule (min_f1_all = 0.5): gene if every member reaches f1_all >= min at gene level; else group if the paralog group reaches it as one unit; else none.
# At each level the cascade (HMM second opinion, osmo_refdb.profile_cascade.tsv) is used only where it raises f1_all; cascade_members lists where it is on.
# f1_all = F1 with every non-background read called as the unit counted as a false positive (own hard negatives and flanks, other panel genes, other families' hard negatives); see compute_metrics.py.
# report_level is families.yaml's report_level; calibration_level is the rule's. tp..f1_all are calibration counts at the reported level and cascade (empty for none).
# f1_all_gene_*: per member, in members order (NA: no HMM threshold, so no cascade option). f1_all_group_*: the paralog group as one unit.
